pages.text:
Vehicle and driver assist settings for MyLincoln TouchTM
can be adjusted on the vibrant LCD screen to the left of the
speedometer. With the left 5-way control on the steering wheel,
choose your display language, check your distance to empty, set
system preferences and so much more. All with your hands on the
wheel. The most frequently used features are repeated on the LCD
screen to the right of the speedometer. Use the 5-way control on the
right side of the steering wheel, or voice commands if you prefer, to
make adjustments while keeping your eyes on the road.
The latest version of our exclusive SYNC® Traffic, Directions
and Information services allows you to listen to turn-by-turn
directions and follow along on-screen with new graphic arrows,
street names and distance markers. You can also get personalized
traffic reports on demand, and set up customized text-message
alerts to help you plan ahead.1
1T raffic alerts and turn-by-turn directions available in select markets. Standard text messaging
and data rates may apply.
FAR BEYOND. EVEN YOUR WILDEST IMAGINATION.
An integrated media hub adds to the extreme versatility of
MyLincoln Touch with 2 USB ports, an SD card reader and audio/
video input jacks. Use them to access music, photos and video.2
Want to see the latest event you captured on your camcorder?
Just plug it in and watch the action on the 8-in. touch screen.
Passengers can even surf the Web on their own portable
devices. Just plug your Wi-Fi® air card into a USB port and
they can visit their favorite websites while you’re on the road.
2 Video only available when the vehicle is in Park.
A rotating display lets you view album covers to select
your songs.3 Browse by touching and moving the slide
bar at the top of the screen.
3O nly available when the vehicle is in Park or moving less than 3 mph.
MyLincoln Touch features correct at time of release. Certain functions require compatible mobile devices.
LINCOLN MKX 2011
lincoln.com
